## SWITCHYARD 90s H3 (lab)

What this graph does: six MiniMax H3 FL2VA columns (379 frames @ 24 fps), last-frame + native audio chained, 22-frame AV head-trim on shots 2–6, then a 2160-frame / 90.00s challenge cap (drop last 4 of the hold).
Do not set length=2164 or 2160 on a single MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo.

Weights: minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot + qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq (CLIP type minimax) + minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16 + minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.
Sampler: res_multistep · simple · 20 steps · CFG 1.0 (BasicGuider) · MiniMaxH3SigmaShift 12 / 3.
SaveVideo prefix: video/SWITCHYARD_90s_H3. CreateVideo fps=24.

Shot map: 6×379 − 5×22 = 2164 unique generated frames (internal). Output keep 2160 frames = 90.00s. Never exceed 90s (Comfy H3 Sync Sound challenge).
22-frame audio-trim caveat: shots 2–6 must TrimAudioDuration start 22/24 s or the concat audio overruns the pictures.
Native H3 audio only — breath and world objects, no external soundtrack.
Challenge: https://blog.comfy.org/p/comfy-h3-sync-sound-community-challenge

Optional: install NikoDemon80/ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context and swap AddGuide+trim for H3MotionContext / H3MotionContextTrim (context_length=22, audio_context_length=24, match_tail=true). Default graph does not depend on that pack.
nodes.title: SWITCHYARD 90s H3 — operator note

widgets_values: Shot 1 of 6. Night freight yard, generic, no railroad company marks. Rain on ballast. Yard lamps. Breath in cold air. Camera walks the gravel. Audio: rain, ballast crunch, distant coupling, no score, no licensed horns from real carriers.
nodes.title: Shot 1 I2V 379

widgets_values: Shot 2 of 6. Between unmarked boxcars. Gravel, puddles, a coupling clank. Gloves on a rusty ladder rail. Audio: rain, metal, breath, no score.
nodes.title: Shot 2 I2V 379

widgets_values: Shot 3 of 6. Climb a generic boxcar ladder in the rain. No logos on the car. Gloves wet. Audio: rungs, rain on steel, breath.
nodes.title: Shot 3 I2V 379

widgets_values: Shot 4 of 6. Roof walk along the string of dark cars. Rain. A distant generic horn, not a real railroad identity. Audio: rain, wind, horn far off, breath, no score.
nodes.title: Shot 4 I2V 379

widgets_values: Shot 5 of 6. Drop back to gravel, splash a puddle, yard-office window glow without readable signage. Audio: splash, gravel, rain, breath.
nodes.title: Shot 5 I2V 379

widgets_values: Shot 6 of 6. Stop under a lamp. Look down the dark string of cars. A quiet, short laugh. Hold. Audio: rain ticking the lamp, breath, no score.
nodes.title: Shot 6 I2V 379
